usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance/t2v (x402, dynamic price) with JSON body {prompt, duration, aspectRatio, outputResolution} -> {success, jobId, status:"pending"}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIGN-IN-WITH-X (free, same wallet) until status="complete"
usage.outputShape: POST -> body.jobId (+status:"pending"). Poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX) -> body.status / body.progress; on body.status=="complete" the asset is at body.result.videoUrl (+ body.result.thumbnailUrl). URLs are Vercel blob links that expire ~20min - download immediately.
quirks: TWO-STEP ASYNC: the POST only pays + returns {jobId, status:pending}; the actual video comes from polling GET /api/jobs/{jobId}, which is SIWX-auth (free) and MUST be signed by the SAME wallet that paid.

DYNAMIC PRICING ABOVE HEADLINE: registry headline is $0.45 but live settle was $1.20 for a 5s 720p clip (price scales with duration/resolution, $0.09-$0.54/s cap). Headline is a floor, not the real cost.
SLOW: video gen took ~6 min (status sat at progress=10 'loading' for several minutes, then jumped 95% -> complete). Poll patiently; budget 10+ polls.
RESULT URLs EXPIRE ~20min: body.result.videoUrl/thumbnailUrl are Vercel blob links - download the asset immediately on completion.
Pays USDC on Base (also Solana/Tempo), no API key. costUsd from qa-pay; on-chain confirmed flag was false (settlement not yet confirmed at capture time).
usage.guide: StableStudio Seedance 2 Pro text-to-video. POST JSON {prompt, duration, aspectRatio, outputResolution} to /api/generate/seedance/t2v with x402 payment (USDC on Base, no API key) - it returns {jobId, status:"pending"} and pays a DYNAMIC price (live: $1.20 for 5s 720p, well above the $0.45 headline). Then poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} using a SIGN-IN-WITH-X signature (free, must be the SAME wallet that paid) every ~20-30s until body.status=="complete" (takes ~6 min). Read the video from body.result.videoUrl and thumbnail from body.result.thumbnailUrl, and DOWNLOAD immediately - the Vercel blob URLs expire in ~20 minutes.
